CDISC-AD0591.Description: Raise an error when, for the same subject, a variable's value does not match the value of the identically named variable in ADSL, considering only records where both values are populated.

ExecutabilityHint.Detail: Declared-token template. The Expansion block binds &VAR to every variable this dataset shares by name with ADSL, and the engine emits one concrete rule per shared variable, each comparing that variable against ADSL's after an inner join on STUDYID / USUBJID — the CDISC-CG0218 / PMDA-AD0208 shape. The join keys are not expanded over: compared against themselves after merging on them they are equal by construction. When ADSL is not among the loaded datasets, or the resolver cannot enumerate other datasets, the rule is skipped with a stated reason rather than expanded to nothing. NARROWING, stated so it is not invisible: the two non_empty guards are carried over verbatim from the pre-expansion rule. The ADSL-side guard suppresses rows whose ADSL value is genuinely empty; a subject absent from ADSL is dropped by the inner join and is reported by CDISC-AD0256, the ADSL-membership rule (D-TA-2). The dataset-side guard means a value present in ADSL but missing here is NOT reported, which ADaMIG 2.3.1 arguably does require; logged as SHEET-ISSUES entry 35 for the sheet author rather than changed here.

Check.expression: not empty(`&VAR`) and not empty(`ADSL.&VAR`) and var_exists(`&VAR`) and var_exists(`ADSL.&VAR`) and `&VAR` != `ADSL.&VAR`

Outcome.Message: For this subject, this variable's value does not match the value of the identically named variable in ADSL.

CDISC-AD0592.Description: Raise an error when, on a BDS or OCCDS record, APERSDT does not equal the ADSL variable APxxSDT for the same USUBJID (where xx equals the record's APERIOD value).

Check.expression: not empty(APERSDT) and not empty(ADSL.AP${APERIOD:%02d}SDT) and APERSDT != ADSL.AP${APERIOD:%02d}SDT

Outcome.Message: On a given record, the value of APERSDT is not equal to the value of variable APxxSDT where xx equals the value of APERIOD

CDISC-AD0598.Description: Raise an error when, on a BDS or OCCDS record, ASPRSDT does not equal the ADSL variable PxxSwSDT for the same USUBJID (where xx equals the record's APERIOD value and w equals the record's ASPER value).

Check.expression: not empty(ASPRSDT) and not empty(ADSL.P${APERIOD:%02d}S${ASPER:%d}SDT) and ASPRSDT != ADSL.P${APERIOD:%02d}S${ASPER:%d}SDT

Outcome.Message: On a given record, the value of ASPRSDT is not equal to the value of variable PxxSwSDT where xx equals the value of APERIOD and w equals the value of ASPER

CDISC-AD0604.Description: Raise an error when, on a BDS or OCCDS record where APHASEN is not present, PHSDT does not equal any ADSL variable PHwSDT (for any w) for the same USUBJID.

Check.expression: not var_exists("APHASEN") and not empty(PHSDT) and PHSDT not in ADSL.PH${*}SDT

Outcome.Message: On a given record, APHASEN is not present and the value of PHSDT is not equal to the value of at least one PHwSDT variable

CDISC-AD0605.Description: Raise an error when, on a BDS or OCCDS record where APHASEN is populated, PHSDT does not equal the ADSL variable PHwSDT for the same USUBJID (where w equals the record's APHASEN value).

Outcome.Message: On a given record, APHASEN is populated and the value of PHSDT is not equal to the value of variable PHwSDT where w equals the value of APHASEN
